projects.description: Self-hosted personal productivity assistant with calendar management, task tracking, AI-powered daily briefings, and natural-language time interpretation.
lines: # ChronoPA
### Self-hosted personal productivity assistant with calendar management, task tracking, AI-powered daily briefings, and natural-language time interpretation.
A self-hosted personal productivity assistant that brings calendar
management, task tracking, intelligent reminders, and AI-powered daily
planning into one platform. Supports a React web application and native
Android application, with a modular backend and multiple AI provider
integrations.
Built with TypeScript · Node.js · Fastify · React · Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · PostgreSQL · Redis · BullMQ · Docker · Claude API · Gemini API · NVIDIA API
[Visit](https://github.com/Tarunmadhav/Chronopa)

projects.description: Modular web application security scanner combining crawling, passive checks, and active testing to analyze application security and generate structured findings.
lines: # AWAVS
### Modular web application security scanner combining crawling, passive checks, and active testing to analyze application security and generate structured findings.
A modular web application security scanner designed to identify common
vulnerabilities in authorized testing environments. It combines web
crawling, passive security checks, and controlled active testing techniques
to analyze application security and generate structured findings with
severity-ranked reports and remediation guidance.
Built with Python · HTTPX · Requests · OWASP ZAP · OWASP Top 10 · Pytest · GitHub Actions
[Visit](https://github.com/Tarunmadhav/WebSCanner)

projects.description: Desktop voice assistant combining offline speech recognition, text-to-speech, and LLM integration for conversational interactions and desktop automation.
lines: # J.A.R.V.I.S
### Desktop voice assistant combining offline speech recognition, text-to-speech, and LLM integration for conversational interactions and desktop automation.
A Python-based desktop voice assistant that combines offline speech
recognition using Vosk, natural voice responses via Microsoft Edge TTS, and
LLM-powered conversational interactions through OpenRouter. Includes
wake-word activation, persistent memory, modular action handlers for desktop
automation and web search.
Built with Python · Vosk · Microsoft Edge TTS · OpenRouter API · PyAutoGUI · SerpApi
[Visit](https://github.com/Tarunmadhav/J.A.R.V.I.S)

projects.description: Network vulnerability assessment tool correlating Nmap service detection with the National Vulnerability Database to identify potential CVEs.
lines: # SentinelScan
### Network vulnerability assessment tool correlating Nmap service detection with the National Vulnerability Database to identify potential CVEs.
A Python-based vulnerability assessment tool that correlates network service
detection results using Nmap with the National Vulnerability Database (NVD).
It identifies potential CVEs associated with detected services and presents
security findings with CVSS-based severity information to support
vulnerability assessment.
Built with Python · Nmap · NVD API · CVE · CVSS · JSON
[Visit](https://github.com/Tarunmadhav/SentinelScan)

projects.description: Read-only AWS security auditing tool examining IAM policies and S3 bucket configurations for common security risks without modifying infrastructure.
lines: # CloudGuard
### Read-only AWS security auditing tool examining IAM policies and S3 bucket configurations for common security risks without modifying infrastructure.
A read-only AWS security auditing tool that examines cloud configurations
for common security risks. It focuses on identifying overly permissive IAM
policies and publicly accessible S3 resources, highlighting configuration
weaknesses with structured security findings and JSON output.
Built with Python · AWS IAM · Amazon S3 · Boto3 · AWS APIs · JSON
[Visit](https://github.com/Tarunmadhav/Cloud-Guard)
